content:
**Smart Shot**, formerly **Master Rifleman**, is a Perception-based perk in *Fallout 76*, renamed and redesigned in the *Gone Fission* update.

Scoped weapons have increased weak spot damage while aiming.

| Rank | Cost | Description | Form ID | 
| ★ | 3 | Deal +25% weak spot damage while aiming a scoped weapon. | 002EBD30 | 

Before update 60, the perk was named "Master Rifleman." It used to have 3 ranks that provided +10%/+15%/+20% damage to non-automatic rifles.
